name: code-object-authz-and-secret-mask
label: code-object-authz-and-secret-mask
comment: Mutations must check `ownedBy` + `writeScope` against the caller's CSS `Principal`; properties marked `exposure: secret` must never be serialized in HTTP or MCP responses. Sources: ADR-052, ADR-048. Narrowed to the mask: hand-written serving code (the generated doors fail closed on exposure=secret) putting a secret-named field into a response it sends. The authz half is the conformance suite's (ADR-052-test-spec), run as its own test. (#4964)

name: code-test-side-effect-isolation
label: code-test-side-effect-isolation
comment: Automated tests must set `BOARD_DRY_RUN=1` / isolated test graphs and must never create live Vikunja cards, send live `osascript` nudges, or mutate prod Fuseki graphs. Sources: DEC-1784. Narrowed: a test file that writes to the prod store (:3030 update/data) or runs a real osascript (no stub or PATH override in the file). (#4964)

name: data-domain-is-punned-owl-class
label: data-domain-is-punned-owl-class
comment: Every `chorus:Domain` must be declared as both `a owl:Class` and `a chorus:Domain` with `rdfs:subClassOf` pointing to its `chorus:Product`. Sources: ADR-045. Narrowed: every chorus:Domain row is also an owl:Class (the pun). The subClassOf-a-Product half is not counted: #4288 made Domain a peer of Product. (#4964)

name: data-no-hardcoded-graph-mappings
label: data-no-hardcoded-graph-mappings
comment: Taxonomy-to-domain and role-ownership mappings must be queried from Fuseki/domain APIs, never hardcoded as lookup tables in `.ts`, `.rs`, or `.sh` source; orphan nodes with zero inbound/outbound edges are forbidden. Sources: ADR-027, ADR-022. Narrowed: source code naming a role as a domain's owner in a literal (owner: "wren", "domain" => "kade"). A comparison is not a mapping. Ownership is the store's ownedBy edge. The orphan-node half is not counted: every row carries rdf:type, so no node has zero edges. (#4964)

name: data-property-key-registered
label: data-property-key-registered
comment: Every `Property.key` used on an instance must match a registered `chorus:PropertyKey` row declaring `appliesTo`, `valueType`, and `cardinality`. Sources: ADR-044. Narrowed: one line per distinct Property.propertyKey value with no PropertyKey row naming it (keyName) and declaring appliesToClass and propertyKind. Cardinality is not modelled on PropertyKey yet, so it is not required. (#4964)

name: data-single-graph-multi-lens
label: data-single-graph-multi-lens
comment: UI views (list, tree, matrix, graph) must project from the same domain API dataset rather than maintaining view-specific stores or duplicate JSON files. Sources: DEC-1786. Narrowed: each SQLite database named in source other than the index cache and buzz is a store kept beside the graph (one line per database, at its first file). (#4964)

name: prod-blast-radius-before-pull
label: prod-blast-radius-before-pull
comment: Cross-domain cards must attach `borg-read-blast-radius` output and owner acknowledgment before `werk-pull` transitions the card to WIP. Sources: DEC-072, DEC-084, DEC-086. Narrowed: a WIP card carrying two or more domain: labels with no blast-radius read on it (the word "blast" in its view). The pull-time refusal is not built; this counts the cards it would have stopped. (#4964)

name: prod-interactive-skill-5s-budget
label: prod-interactive-skill-5s-budget
comment: User-invocable skills must emit initial status/output within 5 seconds and format routine operational events as single-line compact summaries. Sources: DEC-035, DEC-071. Narrowed: the 5 seconds can only be timed by running a skill under a model, so this counts what makes them reachable: a user-invocable skill whose first command block is one command. A skill with no command block, or several commands first, is counted. (#4964)

name: prod-private-by-default-graduation
label: prod-private-by-default-graduation
comment: New personal data domains and attributes default to `jb:visibility "private"`; exposing data to `household` or `public` routes requires an explicit graduation rule on the card. Sources: ADR-002, ADR-003, DEC-068. Narrowed: one line per personal-data graph (urn:gathering:*, ICD graphs aside) where no record carries jb:hasVisibility, the predicate the data uses (the rule text says jb:visibility, which nothing uses). The graduation rule on the card is not decidable from rows. (#4964)

name: prod-service-design-html-first
label: prod-service-design-html-first
comment: Architectural/multi-service features require a Jeff-reviewed HTML service design doc using the consumer-first plain-English template before implementation cards move to WIP. Sources: ADR-029, DEC-081. Narrowed to the files: a service design kept as markdown, and a *-service-design.html missing a mandatory section (Consumers, Validation, Failure modes) or its mermaid consumer diagram. Whether a card needed one before WIP is not decidable. (#4964)

name: qual-domain-fitness-functions
label: qual-domain-fitness-functions
comment: Every active `chorus:Domain` must declare at least one executable fitness function checking live runtime reality against graph declarations. Sources: ADR-056. Narrowed: every chorus:Domain row is the object of at least one chorus:FitnessFunction row. ADR-056 is Proposed and no FitnessFunction row exists yet, so today every domain counts; the ceiling holds it there. (#4964)

name: qual-golden-api-regression
label: qual-golden-api-regression
comment: Any change to an API serializer, domain model, or response envelope must run against committed golden response fixtures. Sources: DEC-2208. Narrowed: each hand-written API handler (platform/api/src/handlers) is named by a regression test under platform/api/tests/regression (golden JSON beside it). (#4964)

name: qual-negative-proof-for-gates
label: qual-negative-proof-for-gates
comment: Every gating check, hook, SHACL shape, or validator added or modified must include an automated negative-proof fixture where a known violation is proven to fail the check. Sources: #3734, ADR-058. Narrowed to the gates that are rows: a policy with a check (not retired) whose violationFixture is unnamed or absent from the tree. Hooks and SHACL shapes have no row tying them to a fixture yet, so they are not counted. (#4964)

name: qual-no-silent-pipeline-drops
label: qual-no-silent-pipeline-drops
comment: Catch blocks and pipeline stages must never swallow errors (`catch {}` or `let _ =` on fallible I/O without logging/returning); every skipped or failed record increments an observable counter. Sources: DEC-1785. Narrowed: an empty catch {} (TS/JS) or Err(_) => {} (Rust) swallows an error with nothing logged or counted. `let _ =` is not counted: most are deliberate best-effort. (#4964)

name: qual-warning-ratchet-downward
label: qual-warning-ratchet-downward
comment: Compiler/Clippy/ESLint warning ceilings may only stay flat or decrease; lock-files (`Cargo.lock`, `package-lock.json`) must be committed and passing `--locked` / `npm ci`. Sources: DEC-085, ADR-026. Narrowed to the lock half: a package.json with no committed package-lock.json beside it, a Cargo workspace with no Cargo.lock. Warning ceilings are already held by the lint ratchet. (#4964)
